data.name: Prdip
data.gender_notes: Prdip is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pradip is derived from the Sanskrit word pradīpa which means a lamp, light or a source of knowledge and wisdom. The name is associated with the Sun god, signifying power, radiance, and enlightenment. The name Prdip carries the meaning “Sun, Power, Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Prdip usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, power, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Pradip is believed to invoke the blessings of the Sun God, Surya, who is considered the source of all energy and life. It is a powerful and auspicious name, often given to boys born on the auspicious day of the Sun.
data.etymology: Prdip belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun, Power, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prdip total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
